items.title: Durability beyond a year is rarely reported
items.whyItMatters: The committee needs effects that last; education faded within a year (c4) and most studies stop at 12 months.
items.opportunity: Extract the latest follow-up point for every strategy and report durability separately.

items.title: Balancing outcomes are thinly reported
items.whyItMatters: Cancellations and complications were reported in a minority of studies; the committee's main worry rests on few data (c3).
items.opportunity: Make cancellations and complications a pre-specified balancing outcome and state where they are missing.

items.title: Strategies are usually combined
items.whyItMatters: Multicomponent studies cannot attribute effects to single components (c5).
items.opportunity: Classify each study by component and compare single and combined strategies descriptively.

items.title: Older patients and patients with previous surgery expect tests
items.whyItMatters: Expectations differ by age and experience; strategies that ignore patients may meet resistance unevenly.
items.opportunity: Extract any subgroup or patient-facing findings.

errorsFound: The need groups 'harm' with cancellations; complications and cancellations are different outcomes and should be extracted separately.
reevaluation: The gaps support a rapid review organised by strategy with durability and balancing outcomes reported explicitly.
summary: Four gaps; durability and balancing outcomes are high severity.
